exposure: history of no previous vaginal delivery
cohort: 53 women with a twin gestation and one previous cesarean delivery undergoing a trial of labor between 2009-2020
finding: Induction of labor after cesarean delivery in twin gestation is associated with an increased risk of TOLAC failure compared to spontaneous onset of labor.
mod_finding: Induction of labor after cesarean delivery in twin gestation is associated with an increased risk of TOLAC failure compared to spontaneous onset of labor.
